{{Quote|Chancellor, I must protest. Besides being the last of its kind, this creature may be intelligent.''"<br />"''I find that hard to believe. It is, after all, just an animal.''"<br />"''It didn't seem to like your comment.|[[Sionver Boll/Legends|Doctor Boll]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Chancellor Palpatine]]|<ref name="ZBSB" />}}
The '''Zillo Beast''' was a semi-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] reptilian-insectoid species endemic to the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. In ancient times, these gargantuan creatures preyed upon a native indigenous species, the [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]]. However, the Dugs gradually gained the upper hand and slowly eradicated the Zillo Beasts through various methods, including drilling for fuel in their habitats. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was widely believed that the creatures were extinct, although it was rumored that at least one had survived.

During the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] deployed an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]] which immobilized a substantial [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] invasion force of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. However, the bomb's tremors inadvertently awakened the [[Unidentified Zillo Beast/Legends|last Zillo Beast]] which went on a destructive rampage. Fearing an apocalypse, the Dugs demanded that the Republic exterminate the beast to which the Republic reluctantly agreed. Seeking to obtain the creature for scientific research, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] covertly arranged for the beast to be immobilized by several [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|stun tanks]], giving the appearance that it had been killed.

This action succeeded in both rendering the Zillo Beast unconscious, and appeasing the Dugs who believed it to be dead. In return, the [[Malastarian council/Legends|Dug Council]] and the Republic ratified The [[Treaty of Malastare/Legends|Treaty of Malastare]] that allowed the Republic access to the planet's fuel reserves. The Zillo Beast was shipped to the galactic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for scientific study but escaped after arrival, putting the lives of millions of residents at risk and forcing the Jedi into action. They eventually managed to kill the Zillo beast, but its body was kept and Palpatine ordered an attempt to clone it.

==Characteristics==
[[File:ZilloBeast-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|Zillo Beasts could walk upright or crawl using all their limbs]]
At 97 meters long,<ref name="TCWCE" /> the Zillo Beasts were gargantuan [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] creatures<ref name="SWE-Zillo Beast">{{SWE|characters|zillobeast|Zillo Beast}}</ref> that dwarfed many other objects and most living organisms in both size and mass in their environment. They had a roughly serpentine body with a long tail that trailed behind its form. It uniquely possessed a third arm protruding from its back. Its plate-like armor was virtually impenetrable to explosives, [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]] and even [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strikes.<ref name="TZB" />

Despite these advantages, a flaw in its protective armor, a small unprotected gap between the plates, allowed some attacks to penetrate and harm the creature. On one occasion, this gap gave enough space for a well-placed energy beam from a [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|stun tank]] to render the beast unconscious. A Zillo beast could also be killed by poisoning it with Malastare fuel. This fuel contained toxins that made it an effective method that the Dugs used for many years.<ref name="TZB" />

The eyes of the Zillo beast glowed a pale yellow-green at all times and its nostrils were located on the top of its skull.<ref name="TZB" /> It appeared intelligent, sensitive, and capable of recognizing facial features as when hunting for Palpatine.<ref name="ZBSB" />

==History==
===Origins===
{{Quote|The Council suspects that the Separatists are here searching for deadly ''natural predators''&hellip; such as the now-extinct ''Zillo Beast''. If their technicians can get a sample of ''Zillo DNA'', they might be able to clone a ''new'' war beast. Imagine a ''pack'' of those loose on Coruscant!|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Dug Out">{{TCWComicCite|6.19|Dug Out}}</ref>}}
[[File:Zillo_beast_attacks.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Zillo Beast attacks [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].]]
The Zillo Beasts were once the dominant species of the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and preyed on the indigenous sentient [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] in ancient times. Over time, the Dugs began drilling their world for [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]], which gradually culminated in the near extinction of the species due to a loss of habitat.<ref name="TZB" /> A company named [[Zillo Fuel Resources]] was even established at some point and worked from Malastare.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

The ancient Dugs were known to have cataloged a list of weaknesses in the creatures, including their vulnerability to fuel due to its flammability and to poisons in the fuel lethal to the Zillo Beasts. However, the ancient Dugs also issued a warning to their future descendants that a Zillo Beast would someday return to destroy their entire civilization. Eventually, it was believed that the species had been eradicated, though it was prophesied that one such creature still survived and would emerge in the future to destroy them. Thus, the Dugs passed down a manuscript through the generations in order to prepare their descendants for such a day.<ref name="TZB" /> During the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]], the Sith Lord [[Darth Malgus]] visited the office of the then defunct [[Berooken|Supreme Chancellor]]. In his office he found a statue he suspected was made of Zillo Beast bones. However, he had only heard rumors of the animals.<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>

===Involvement in the Clone Wars===
At some point [[Garnac's hunting guild/Legends|Garnac's hunting guild]] took remains from Zillo Beasts and placed them in their [[Ubrikkian floating fortress]].<ref name="Padawan Lost">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Malastare faced the threat of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|invasion]]<ref name="TZB" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="The Zillo Beast Date">{{TCWdates|218}}</ref> which sought access to its substantial fuel reserves. In response, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched a sizable army of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to secure the key Republic world's fuel reserves and to recruit the Dugs as allies. This mission was overseen by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which sent [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to lead the campaign. However, the sheer number of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on the planet led to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] authorizing the deployment of a new weapon&mdash;the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]]. The weapon successfully obliterated the droid army but inadvertently awakened the last Zillo Beast, which wreaked havoc among the survivors of the battle.<ref name="TZB" />

Panicked and aware of their ancestors' warning, the Dugs made preparations to slay the creature and demanded that the Republic assist them, otherwise, Malastare would not ratify the treaty that would allow its fuel reserves to be used for the war effort. However, Master Windu refused to support this action, as he regarded this as the murder of an innocent life-form. Despite his protestations, the Chancellor publicly supported the action, but secretly sought to capture the beast alive for scientific research.<ref name="TZB" />

A [[Sionver Boll/Legends|scientific adviser]] close to him intended to study the Zillo Beast's impervious hide and replicate it synthetically for the Grand Army of the Republic's benefit. At the suggestion of Skywalker, Palpatine agreed to conduct an elaborate attack designed to stun the Zillo Beast using particle cannon fire, which would penetrate the gaps in its armor and render it unconscious. Once stunned, the Zillo Beast would appear dead enough to appease the Dugs and allow for the signing of the treaty. Once in a coma, the creature was to be transported to an undisclosed peaceful world in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] where it could be studied and then released back into the wild.<ref name="TZB" />

[[File:LAATcZilloBeast-TZB.png|thumb|left|250px|The Zillo Beast being airlifted by several LAAT/c gunships]]
However, the Dugs were already prepared to slay the creature and began dumping fuel into the pit where it was located in order to kill it. This act only enraged the beast, driving it to emerge from its pit and it wreaked untold devastation on both the Dugs and Republic forces. However, the use of the stun tank's power beam enabled the Jedi to knock out the creature.<ref name="TZB" />

With the treaty signed, the Zillo Beast's body awaited transportation, but Chancellor Palpatine ordered a change in plans. Instead of being taken to its secret Outer Rim destination, the scientists wanted the specimen studied in a contained environment. Thus, it was agreed for the creature to be taken to the galactic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="TZB" /> where preparations were made for its arrival.<ref name="ZBSB" />

===Creating havoc===
{{Main|Zillo Beast incident/Legends}}
After the Zillo Beast was transported to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], it was studied by Dr. [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]]. Chancellor Palpatine oversaw the operation, and he ordered the doctor to kill it, so that they could extract the beast's scales for study. Seeing this from its prison, the Zillo Beast growled fiercely and glared at the Chancellor with unfettered rage. In addition, the Zillo Beast possibly also sensed Palpatine's true nature as a Sith Lord, Darth Sidious. The doctor reluctantly accepted her orders and produced gas from Malastarian fuel, which had, according to the Dugs, already been successfully used to subdue, and even kill, Zillo Beasts. As it was sprayed with the gas, the Zillo Beast went berserk at exposure to the gas, and managed to break out of its restraints, and escaped the building in which it had been held. It rampaged around Coruscant, killing hundreds, if not thousands, of innocents before charging towards the Senate, intent on revenge upon Palpatine for ordering its execution. Although the Beast eventually had the Chancellor's ship in its grasp, action on the part of Anakin Skywalker ensured that Palpatine escaped. The beast was killed by the Republic working with the Jedi, using flares to make it roar so missiles full of the poison could be shot into its mouth. The monster's huge body finally toppled from the Senate Building dead, paying the ultimate price for the mistakes of Palpatine and others in power. After its death, the Zillo Beast's body was sent back to the Doctor with her new orders&mdash;orders to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] the Zillo Beast.<ref name="ZBSB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ZilloBeast-TZB.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Zillo Beast concept art]]
The Zillo Beast premiered in "[[The Zillo Beast]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]].<ref name="TZB" /> Much of the plot of the Zillo Beast is a homage to the [[Wikipedia:Godzilla|Godzilla]] films and other giant monster movies. The main plot is reminiscent of the original [[1950s|1954]] movie where an American nuclear test roused the monster who then made his way straight to Tokyo. Some other references include drawings on several [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] helmets and [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|stun tanks]], as well as insignia on a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Malastare)|T-series tactical droid's]] chest.<ref name=":0">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode218.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Zillo Beast}}</ref>

In the video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' the Zillo Beast wears a gold collar that stuns it when destroyed, and, in a humorous take on the episode in which the Zillo Beast appeared, the beast is subdued with a pacifier and carried away by Republic gunships&mdash;along with a baby mobile, and a massive milk bottle carried by clone troopers.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>

The Zillo beast was the focus of a non-canon event in the digital card game ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''. An event entitled "The Ancient Terror" was held [[August 21]]&ndash;[[August 28]], [[2014]], and had players in a joint effort to defeat Zillo Beast clones unleashed on Coruscant by the Separatists.<ref name="Star Wars: Force Collection">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''</ref>
